title: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1: 52.6% on Terminal-Bench-Science and 75% Cheaper Cache Reads
summary: Anthropic has released Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, the same model behind two different safeguard layers. Fable 5.1 is generally available on the Claude API, AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry; Mythos 5.1 remains restricted to vetted organizations under Project Glasswing. Fable 5.1 scores 52.6% on Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 against 24.7% for Fable 5, ships a 1M token context window, and drops cache reads 75% to $0.25 per million tokens while base pricing holds at $10 and $50. Three API changes are breaking, including the removal of forced tool use. The post Anthropic Releases Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1: 52.6% on Terminal-Bench-Science and 75% Cheaper Cache Reads appeared first on MarkTechPost .

summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 (general availability) and Mythos 5.1 (restricted). Fable 5.1 scores 52.6% on Terminal-Bench-Science, has 1M context, and cuts cache read costs by 75%. Three breaking API changes.
summary_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Fable 5.1（全面可用）和Mythos 5.1（受限）。Fable 5.1在Terminal-Bench-Science得分52.6%，支持1M上下文，缓存读取成本降低75%，并有三个破坏性API变更。
